name: Gonadorelin
storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Gonadorelin (GND) is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 2 pack sizes: 2 mg, 10 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Gonadorelin tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each GND lot is run on RP-HPLC against a ≥99.0% (HPLC) release limit, then confirmed by MS. The batch certificate carries the measured purity, retention time and mass together with the identity string (CAS 33515-09-2, formula C55H75N17O13, 1182.3 Da).

faq.question: How should Gonadorelin be stored?
faq.answer: Hold the sealed 10-vial kit at −20 °C, away from light and humidity. Once reconstituted, aliquot and keep at 2–8 °C; this GND preparation does not tolerate repeated freeze–thaw.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Gonadorelin?
faq.answer: Gonadorelin is stocked in 2 pack sizes (2 mg, 10 mg), 10 vials per kit, MOQ 1 kit. At 1–9 kits the per-kit price is $15.32; 10–49 kits falls to $14.10 (−8%) and 50+ to $13.02 (−15%).

compliance: For Research, Laboratory, and Analytical Use Only. Not for Human or Veterinary Use.
